stem: The boundary line demarcating the partition of British India into India and Pakistan in 1947, drawn by a British lawyer who had never previously visited India, is known as the:
explanation: Sir Cyril Radcliffe drew the Partition boundary (the Radcliffe Line) in 1947 under severe time pressure — distinct from the McMahon Line (India-China border) or the Durand Line (Pakistan-Afghanistan border), which mark entirely different frontiers.
